rationale:
Second batch of handler-side commit_sha standardisation for bugs_open/334 (RFC_029 step 5's real gate), following migration 519 (page-rerender, submitted, awaiting verdict). Same mechanism, same council-approved shape: nav-updater is a real, live bdl handler (confirmed against site_work_items.handler_agent, the top-level dispatch column, not a static list) with its own direct git_commit step. Single direct git_commit step (deploy_js_snippets), whose next_step is get_pages — runs BEFORE check_has_pages/create_rerender_items on every path to complete, so js_snippets_deployed is already in collected_data regardless of which branch is taken. No second git-touching call — same simple shape as rerender-pages.

Same conversion as 519 and the same reason it is required, not merely convenient: nav-updater's `complete` step currently uses `output_fields` (list mode), which uses each entry as both the extraction path and the response key — a dotted path added to the list would produce a response key that is that literal string, invisible to any dot-path reader. `result_mapping` is the only mode that builds an independently-named target<-source map, and it is mutually exclusive with `output_fields`. So this is a controlled conversion: every currently-exposed field re-declared as an identity mapping (byte-identical response for existing readers), plus one new `commit_sha` entry.
